vBRIEFInfo.description: Assign scope:complete ownership for stop-at:pr-open and add orphaned active/running xBRIEF guard.

plan.title: stop-at:pr-open must not leave orphaned active/running xBRIEFs on master

narratives.Description: Workers dispatched stop-at:pr-open never run scope:complete. When they commit an activation checkpoint, the running xBRIEF rides into master on merge and permanently consumes a WIP slot. Orchestrator doctrine must own post-merge complete/cancel, and a deterministic gate must detect orphaned active/running briefs whose issues are closed or PR merged.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Update content/templates/agent-prompt-preamble.md §9 (#1880) and content/skills/deft-directive-swarm/SKILL.md (or agents-entry mirror) so stop-at:pr-open assigns orchestrator post-merge scope:complete/cancel ownership, and drive-to:merge-ready workers include scope:complete in their unit of work. 2. Add a deterministic verify verb (e.g. packages/core/src/scope or check/) that fails when active/ contains status=running briefs whose referenced issues are all closed or whose linked PR is merged; wire into task check or document as default-branch guard. 3. Add regression tests covering the orphan signature. 4. CHANGELOG [Unreleased]; task agents:refresh if agents-entry changes. Prefer not to block on Story Start Gate activation-checkpoint redesign unless a small docs note fits.
narratives.UserStory: As a maintainer merging stop-at:pr-open worker PRs, I want explicit scope:complete ownership and an orphan-active gate, so that shipped work cannot leave running xBRIEFs on master.

narrative.Acceptance: Given agent-prompt-preamble §9 / swarm skill surfaces, when an orchestrator dispatches stop-at:pr-open, then the docs require the orchestrator to run scope:complete or scope:cancel after merge; drive-to:merge-ready docs require the worker to complete the xBRIEF.
Given an active/running xBRIEF whose referenced issues are all closed (or linked PR merged), when the orphan guard runs, then it fails closed with a clear remediation pointing at scope:complete.
Given the guard and docs land, when tests and task check wiring (if added) run, then the orphan signature is covered; CHANGELOG [Unreleased] notes the fix.
